title: Sludge biochar-enabled trace voltammetric detection of 2,2′,4,4′-tetrabromodiphenyl ether in water samples
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43595-43604
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06052D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ganquan Zhang, Yuanping Li, Shunyao Jia, Yaoning Chen, Tianyun Zhou, Li Zhu, Nianping Chi, Yanting Wu, Wenqiang Luo
Sludge-derived biochar enables sensitive BDE-47 detection without pretreatment. The modified electrode achieved a 5 ng L−1 detection limit and was validated in real water samples, offering a robust tool for POPs monitoring.
